description: This file contains implementations of URL parsing, normalization, matching, and related utilities. It includes functions for escaping, URL normalization, host and path matching, and configuration integration specific to URL matching logic.

methods.name: int append_normalized_escapes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * from,size_t from_len,const char * esc_extra,const char * esc_ok)
methods.description: Escapes or unescapes characters in a string for URL safety, normalizing percent-encodings and handling extra escape characters.

methods.name: const char * end_of_token(const char * s,int c,size_t n)
methods.description: Finds the end of a token in a string delimited by a specified character within a length limit.

methods.name: int match_host(const struct url_info * url_info,const struct url_info * pattern_info)
methods.description: Compares the host parts of two URL info structures, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: char * url_normalize_1(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info,char allow_globs)
methods.description: Performs comprehensive normalization of a URL string including case conversion, escaping, path resolution, and removing default ports.

methods.name: char * url_normalize(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info)
methods.description: A wrapper function that calls url_normalize_1 with globs not allowed.

methods.name: size_t url_match_prefix(const char * url,const char * url_prefix,size_t url_prefix_len)
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a prefix, considering implicit slashes and boundary conditions.

methods.name: int match_urls(const struct url_info * url,const struct url_info * url_prefix,struct urlmatch_item * match)
methods.description: Determines if a URL matches a URL prefix based on scheme, host, port, and path.

methods.name: int cmp_matches(const struct urlmatch_item * a,const struct urlmatch_item * b)
methods.description: Compares two URL match items for sorting by specificity.

methods.name: int urlmatch_config_entry(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures URL match entries based on string parsing and matching logic, used within configuration context.

methods.name: void urlmatch_config_release(struct urlmatch_config * config)
methods.description: Releases resources allocated for URL match configuration.
